record.original_question: For the variety IMMr,V ⊆ P(S^dV) of homogeneous polynomials admitting an algebraic branching program of width at most r, determine defining equations for small r and small dim(V).

evidence.quote: Problem 17. Determine equations for IMMr,V ⊆ PS d V for small values of r and dim V .

artifact.status_search_result: Determining defining equations of varieties of polynomials computable by small-width algebraic branching programs is an actively studied geometric-complexity problem. The literature provides structural results (e.g., tangent spaces, border-complexity bounds) but no complete set of defining equations for these varieties in general, even for small $r$ and small $\dim V$. The question appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Algebraic Branching Programs, Border Complexity, and Tangent Spaces
status_evidence.snippet: Study of tangent spaces and border complexity for ABP varieties, without giving full defining equations.
status_evidence.claim: Geometric study of ABP varieties is ongoing; defining equations are not fully known.

status_evidence.title: On Algebraic Branching Programs of Small Width
status_evidence.snippet: Investigates polynomial families computable by small-width ABPs and their approximative closures.
status_evidence.claim: Small-width ABP classes are characterized in terms of complexity but explicit ideal generators for the corresponding varieties are not given.
